concepts.gloss_en: The renewal/creation of the world (the general concept that God renews creation and can override nature)

members.note: representative; used as the general theological principle of world-renewal, tied to prayer and belief in a Renewer who changes nature

concepts.gloss_en: The future renewal of the world (the eschatological event when the world will be conducted by wonders/providence, not nature)

members.note: specifies a distinct future/eschatological referent — a specific event rather than the general principle; 'לעתיד' narrows the head to a time-bound occurrence. Under-merge per rules 1 and 4.

notes: Both share the head 'חדוש העולם' but the qualifier 'לעתיד' points to the specific future/messianic renewal (conduct by wonders), whereas the bare form is the general principle. Kept separate per under-merge preference; a reviewer may decide the future renewal is a sub-instance of the same concept.
